structure: CSharp keeps RuntimeReference.PointerName distinct from the loaded RuntimeStruct value; EmitReferencePlace recursively projects the field from the canonical source pointer. SLG control-region member emission invokes the parameter/projection-only writeReferencePlaceValue helper, which prints a materialized local Name SSA rather than its pointer-producing binding root.

The fourth control-region consumer emits members in while/if bodies; its canonical-reference and fallback-reference GEP branches both need the existing forwarded-reference place writer. The by-value extractvalue branch must remain a value, not be changed to a pointer.
logic: Use writeForwardedReferenceValue at the two pointer-only control-region member sites, preserving current semantic member field type/ordinal and all source/scheduling decisions. Review the other raw place-writer callers as separate pointer/value contracts; do not globally rewrite extractvalue/parameter behavior.
diagnostics: No source admission, warning, stderr/stdout, expected exit or LLVM assembly acceptance changes. Existing assembly rejection is preserved.
scope: C716 control-region continuation after full16609 failed at the same retained pointer mismatch. No new full emission until focused source regression covers this exact missing path.
